hero_description.en: In the public and non-profit sectors, effective decisions depend on understanding the people you serve — how they access information, use technology, and engage with media. The Media Technology Monitor (MTM) provides trusted Canadian data that helps organizations design better programs, improve communications, and make evidence-based decisions with confidence.

Insights overview -topics directly relev.key: Insights overview -topics directly relevant to government and what decisions it informs. (use cases but indirect)

insights_title.en: Insights That Support Better Public Decisions

insights_description.en: Access current, nationally representative data on how Canadians consume media and technology. MTM helps governments and NGOs better understand audiences, evaluate communications strategies, and identify emerging behavioural shifts across demographic groups and regions.

insight_1_description.en: of newcomers aged 35 to 44 have used employment services since arriving in Canada

insight_1_variables.en: Age Group, Employment services used, Other settlement services used

insight_1_informs.en: Funding and resource allocation, awareness campaign targeting age specific approaches for federal programs.

insight_2_description.en: of teens used TikTok in the past month

insight_2_variables.en: TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat, Linkedin, Whatsapp

insight_2_informs.en: Platform selection for public outreach, regulatory review of social media reach, and audience segmentation for government communications.

insight_3_description.en: Indigenous people are less likely to be using LinkedIn than other people living in Canada.

insight_3_informs.en: Understanding what social platforms Canadians are using can ensure that your next campaign to find new employees has the greatest impact.

MTM Reports as the solution for how they.key: MTM Reports as the solution for how they can access those insights (second highest report users)

gov_ngos_tools_census_description.en: Map your audience at the postal code level. Identify underserved communities, size local markets, and benchmark your reach against the national population — all from a single dashboard sourced directly from Statistics Canada census data.

gov_ngos_tools_analytic_description.en: Query MTM's full dataset by platform, region, language, and demographic. Build custom cross-tabs in minutes, track adoption curves over time, and model where your audience will be in three years — all at the click of a button.

usecases_title.en: MTM in Action for Public Sector Teams

usecases_description.en: Learn how the MTM offers reports and content that can inform decisions based on robust, tried and true survey results.

usecase_1_description.en: A committee needs information about the success of foreign versus domestic streaming services in Canada, and adoption across income levels.

usecase_1_variables.en: SVOD, Netflix, Music Streaming Services, Spotify, income

usecase_1_cta.en: Consult the Audio and SVOD reports which offer a detailed overview of the most popular video and music streaming services and their users.

usecase_2_description.en: A team is looking for information on the performance of different cellphone providers across different regions.

usecase_2_cta.en: Find our latest cellphone report to begin, then go deeper with the data analysis tool to find actionable insights.

testimonial_title.en: What government and NGO partners are saying about us

testimonial_quote.en: Thanks to our subscription to MTM Newcomers, we have access to newcomer data insights and their settlement and integration journey in Manitoba. We particularly appreciate seeing information that is not available through any other sources, like newcomers' use of media, devices, and newcomer knowledge of services available through our sector. This information helps our members ensure that their services are well adapted to the needs and characteristics of the newcomers they serve.

testimonial_attribution.en: Valeria Castellanos,  Language Support and Program Manager - MANSO
